description: Partnership for Energy Efficiency Building Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a Partnership for Energy Efficiency Building Programme under a Financial Grant provided as per the original Agreement regarding technical co-operation between the Federal Republic of Germany and the Republic of Sri Lanka. The programme is scheduled to be implemented by the GIZ (Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit GmbH) of the Federal Republic of Germany and monitored by the Ministry of Energy and the Sustainable Energy Authority. The main objective of the programme is to support Sri Lanka in obtaining policies, institutional frameworks and technical assistance for the maintenance of energy-efficient and climate-resilient buildings. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to sign an Agreement among the Ministry of Energy, the Department of External Resources and the Country Representative of GIZ to implement the said programme under a total Financial Grant of EUR 924,063 (approximately 314 million Sri Lankan Rupees), was approved by the Cabinet.
